item.description:
• Moved the "Add More" button to the left side of the toolbar, next to the ... menu.
  • Custom About panel: Acknowledgements and Check for Updates now live as buttons inside About, instead of separate menu bar items.
• New "Add More..." toolbar button: append additional photos to the current batch without replacing what's already loaded.

• Full UI rewrite: one always-visible view (thumbnails / preview / settings), replacing the old Guided-wizard + Compact dual-mode design.
  • Type-in text watermarks (Create My Watermark), with a warning if the text looks like it contains a phone number.
  • Persistent watermark library -- pick from previously used watermarks, star one as your default.
  • Appearance control: Original / Light / Dark / Alternating (tiled) / Inverted, plus a contrast slider for the watermark itself.
  • Directional nudge controls for fine positioning, replacing confusing +/- coordinate fields.
  • Automatic recovery when export hits a folder-permission error -- picks a new folder and retries instead of just failing.
  • Fixed: rotation only worked in Tiled mode, not Single, despite the export logic already supporting both.

• New "Remove watermark background" option: strips a solid/near-solid background from the watermark image itself at export time -- for watermarks that weren't prepared as a proper transparent PNG. Off by default. Available in the app (Watermark source section) and the wf-metadata CLI (--remove-background).

• Fixed missing automality.com attribution on JPEG exports (the TIFF Software/Artist tags were silently dropped by ImageIO for that format; added a working carrier via EXIF).
  • New Location metadata control in Export settings: remove GPS entirely, reduce it to ~1km precision, or keep exact coordinates. Original/hidden metadata (camera info, AI-generation descriptions, embedded thumbnails) was already always removed -- this only affects GPS specifically.
  • New headless CLI (wf-metadata) for scripting the same watermark/resize/metadata-privacy pipeline without opening the app.
• Fixed exports that failed with no explanation ("Failed: file.jpg" and nothing else) -- the real error was being discarded. Now shows what actually went wrong for each file.
• Watermark All Images moved to the top-right header on the Export stage -- orange, always visible, no more scrolling to the bottom of the settings to find it.
